title: Yucatec Maya language
description: Mayan language spoken in Mexico and Belize
extract: Yucatec Maya, referred to by its speakers as mayaʼ or maayaʼ t’aan, is a Mayan language spoken in the Yucatán Peninsula, including part of northern Belize. There is also a significant diasporic community of Yucatec Maya speakers in San Francisco, though most Maya Americans are speakers of other Mayan languages from Guatemala and Chiapas.
